latin: Contingens rerum quae sunt, erunt, aut fuerunt, existentia ideo deo ab aeterno fuit infallibiliter nota, quia fuit aeternitati eius praesentialiter praeposita.

mentions.context: via Thomas, refers clearly to the Holy Spirit. Pico is accurate here but obviously his thesis, which includes different formulation and wording, does not reflect all the theological nuances and implications found in Thomas.
